title: How OpenClaw works
brief:
OpenClaw is the software running your assistant.
Hostinger is the computer in the cloud that keeps it running.
An AI model is the intelligence behind it.
Telegram/Whatsapp is the way to communicate with it.

scenes.headline: Four parts, working together as one assistant.
scenes.narration: Let's look at how an OpenClaw setup works. It's four parts, working together as one assistant.

scenes.headline: OpenClaw is the software that runs your assistant.
scenes.narration: First, OpenClaw. This is the software that runs your assistant. It receives your messages, works out what to do, and sends the replies.

scenes.headline: Hostinger is the computer in the cloud that keeps it running.
scenes.narration: OpenClaw needs a computer to run on. That's Hostinger: a computer in the cloud that stays on day and night, so your assistant keeps working even when your laptop is closed.

scenes.headline: An AI model is the intelligence behind it.
scenes.narration: Next, the AI model. This is the intelligence behind it. OpenClaw passes your request to a model like Claude, GPT or Gemini, which works out the answer.

scenes.headline: Telegram or WhatsApp is how you talk to it.
scenes.narration: And finally, Telegram or WhatsApp. That's how you talk to your assistant, using the chat app that's already on your phone.

scenes.headline: You send a message. OpenClaw asks the AI. The reply comes back.
scenes.narration: Put it all together. You send a message, OpenClaw picks it up on its cloud computer, asks the AI model, and the reply comes straight back to your chat.
